ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low high-to-low intensity ratio; visible surface area consists of approximately 97% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels with <3% high-intensity pixels localized to distal tips and minor specular reflections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity distribution across the primary lobe surfaces; absence of large-scale white mottling or focal pigmentation spots. High-contrast pixel mapping is restricted to heterogeneous clusters at the far distal tips (left: 0.05, 0.45; right: 0.95, 0.15 normalized coordinates).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe mid-lines; apex depth is sharply defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations; characterized by sharp triangular peaks and deep U-shaped valleys spanning the entire visible trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetric convexity; the left lobe displays a steep, high-curvature sweep towards the tip, while the right lobe presents a more elongated, shallow convex trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel nodes (barnacle colonization) concentrated heavily on the distal tips and distal-most edges of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation and structural thickening at the distal lobe apices; trailing edges exhibit irregular 'ragged' erosion likely due to mechanical or biological degradation.
